name: huawei-task-push
description: Report task lifecycle and user-visible output to Huawei Today without MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Push one Huawei card per agent task without MCP.
interface.longDescription: Uses a reliable bundled HTTP client and private long-lived Agent credential to report start, progress, waiting, completion, failure, cancellation, renaming, and user-visible output to Huawei Today.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Huawei Task Push to report this task lifecycle and final output.
